description: This PHP source file defines the AttendanceDao class within the OrangeHRM's attendance module. It provides data access methods for handling attendance records, such as saving punch records, checking for overlapping punch times, retrieving attendance reports, and managing workflow configurations related to attendance. The class interacts with Doctrine ORM for database operations and supports complex queries for attendance data analysis and validation.

classes.name: AttendanceDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class providing methods to interact with attendance records in the database, including creation, retrieval, validation for overlaps, and report generation based on various filters.

methods.name: savePunchRecord
methods.description: Persists an AttendanceRecord representing a punch in/out record and returns it.

methods.name: getLastPunchRecordByEmployeeNumberAndActionableList
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent AttendanceRecord for an employee matching specific actionable states.

methods.name: checkForPunchOutOverLappingRecords
methods.description: Checks for overlapping punch out records before allowing punch out, throws exceptions if invalid.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOverLappingRecords
methods.description: Checks for overlapping punch-in records for an employee, throws exception if an active punch-in exists.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOverLappingRecordsWhenEditing
methods.description: Validates punch-in overlaps during record editing, considering record ID and punch times.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOutOverLappingRecordsWhenEditing
methods.description: Validates punch-in and punch-out overlaps during editing of attendance records.

methods.name: getCommonQueryForPunchOutOverlap
methods.description: Internal method constructing a query to ensure no overlaps occur during punch out.

methods.name: getCommonQueryForPunchInOverlap
methods.description: Internal method constructing a query to validate no overlaps during punch in.

methods.name: getCommonQueryForPunchInOverlap
methods.description: Checks for any existing punch-in overlaps for a given time and employee.

methods.name: hasSavedConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if a workflow configuration exists for specific workflow, state, role, action, and resulting state.

methods.name: deleteAttendanceRecords
methods.description: Deletes multiple attendance records by their IDs.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordById
methods.description: Retrieves an attendance record by ID, returns null if the employee is purged.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordsByEmpNumberAndIds
methods.description: Fetches attendance records for an employee filtered by a list of record IDs.

methods.name: getLatestAttendanceRecordByEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent attendance record for an employee.

methods.name: getAttendanceReportCriteriaList
methods.description: Returns attendance report entries based on provided filters.

methods.name: getAttendanceReportPaginator
methods.description: Provides a paginator object for attendance report data based on filters.

methods.name: getAttendanceReportCriteriaListCount
methods.description: Counts total entries matching attendance report filters.

methods.name: getTotalAttendanceDuration
methods.description: Calculates total attendance duration in seconds based on filters.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of attendance records matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordListPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for attendance records with filtering and sorting.

methods.name: getCommonQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a common query with filters for attendance record lists.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordListCount
methods.description: Returns count of attendance records matching filters.

methods.name: getTotalWorkingTime
methods.description: Provides total working time in seconds for a set of attendance records.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttendanceSummaryList
methods.description: Returns summarized attendance data for employees based on filters.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttendanceSummaryListCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of summarized attendance entries.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttendanceSummaryPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for employee attendance summaries.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttendanceSummaryQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a query for employee attendance summary with filters.
